node: Compound semiconductor epitaxy and MOCVD tools for lasers, photonics, SiC, GaN, and optical components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the compound-semiconductor epitaxy/MOCVD equipment node. The cleanest direct public exposures are Veeco and Aixtron ADRs, both tied to MOCVD/deposition systems for compound semiconductors and photonics. MKS is a second-order subsystem supplier to semiconductor process tools rather than a pure epitaxy-tool maker. CVD Equipment is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate with CVD/thermal-process exposure to SiC/GaN-adjacent markets but weak proof of qualified AI-optical customer pull-through.
